column_description: A VARCHAR(20) primary key for moderation records (e.g., 'MOD001').
A SMALLINT count of how many times the fan was reported (e.g., 2).
A SMALLINT count of how many warnings were issued to the fan (e.g., 1).
An enum (ViolationHistory_enum) describing any prior infractions (Major, Minor).
An enum (ModerationStatus_enum) showing moderation status (Warning, Good Standing, Restricted).
An enum (ContentCompliance_enum) for compliance with content policy (Warning, Violation, Compliant).
An enum (AgeVerification_enum) indicating age verification state (Not Required, Verified, Pending).
An enum (PaymentVerification_enum) verifying payment info (Pending, Verified).
A VARCHAR(50) capturing any identity verification code or status (e.g., 'IDCheck#123').
